headline: Medical Records Clerk
summary: Health information graduate looking for a first job in a hospital records section. During my internship I transcribed physicians' dictated notes, encoded discharge summaries and learned the medical terms behind them. Fast, accurate typist and careful with confidential information.

experience.title: Medical Records Intern
experience.paragraph: Four-month internship in the records section of a 200-bed private hospital.
bullets: Transcribed dictated operative and consultation notes for three physicians.
Encoded discharge summaries and ICD codes into the hospital information system.
Retrieved and refiled charts for audits and follow-up clinics.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Health Information Management
education.school: Metro North College of Health Sciences
